headline: Arsenal's Bukayo Saka out for a month, William Saliba available - Mikel Arteta
description: Arsenal manager Mikel Arteta expects Bukayo Saka to be sidelined for another four weeks with the thigh injury that has already kept the England winger out for a month.

headline: Mikel Arteta: Steps taken to avoid team leaks due to Fantasy Premier League
description: Mikel Arteta has said Arsenal have taken steps to avoid future team leaks via Fantasy Premier League after Christos Tzolis inadvertently revealed information through his own selections in the game.

headline: Mikel Arteta warns of drone breach risk after Man United training incident
description: Mikel Arteta has described Manchester United's training ground drone breach as a "serious issue" and warned of the risk of future problems across the Premier League.

headline: Drone operator who filmed Mauricio Pochettino at Man United apologises
description: The operator of the drone that filmed Mauricio Pochettino's first training session at Manchester United accepts it was "unethical."

headline: Estêvão is Brazil's brightest young talent. Is Chelsea the right place for him?
description: Estêvão is widely regarded as Brazil's brightest young talent, but he has struggled for playing time at Chelsea this season. What's behind his lack of minutes?

headline: Mauricio Pochettino's Man United squad audit: Should Fernandes, Rashford stay?
description: New Manchester United manager Mauricio Pochettino inherits a squad built by his six predecessors. Which players have a future at the club, and which should go?
